statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. For a time t, let G(t) be the undirected graph on vertices {0,1,...,n-1} whose edges are exactly the unordered pairs {x(i),y(i)} for all i with ts(i) <= t. If there exists a timestamp t equal to some ts(i) such that G(t) is connected, then r is the least such timestamp. If no timestamp t equal to some ts(i) makes G(t) connected, then r = -1. Equivalently, r is the earliest time at which every pair of people is in one connected acquaintance component using all friendship events with timestamp <= r, or -1 if no such time exists.
